existing_reusable_mechanisms.actual: Native sentence/word ranges; contiguous 1–8-word windows; exact original UTF16 geometry; French enumerated elision start; no cross-sentence windows.
existing_reusable_mechanisms.limitation: Current consumer needs full translation and target-side evidence. Returning these windows does not authorize source-only use of existing mappings.

existing_reusable_mechanisms.actual: Finite literal/focus/enumerated-slot matching against the entire supplied fragment. Exactly one focus; all input must be consumed.
existing_reusable_mechanisms.limitation: Slots admit source context, not open text copying, target generation, target agreement or recursive grammar. Pure Focus needs existing ContextFrame lexical-unit path.

existing_reusable_mechanisms.actual: Exact whole message, then exact complete sentences; ambiguity in matched whole is not erased by smaller-context fallback.
ICU sentence/word segmentation; existing Kuromoji for Japanese word units and read-only morphological tokens.
existing_reusable_mechanisms.limitation: No general multilingual morphological transducer; only existing explicit dictionary evidence can supply finite forms.

existing_reusable_mechanisms.actual: Source-only phrase/unit slots, provenance, native token costs, mandatory non-Roman reading, original speech/copy and optional complete reference.
existing_reusable_mechanisms.limitation: Structural anchoring is not semantic authorization. Does not create translations.

proposed_shared_comparison_arms.description: Exact clean committed existing routing and separately frozen reviewed word-only candidate if its allowlist is approved; report independently rather than silently merging.
Whole approved source reference first, then complete sentence/longest indexed native windows down to shorter windows; fixed approved target phrase only. No generated translation prerequisite.

Same phrase traversal plus finite enumerated source-context slots, with replacement limited to the explicitly reviewed focus. Slots remain original text unless a separate fully enumerated bilingual template is explicitly assessed.
Same finite templates with independently supplied complete attested source forms/feature constraints. No stem fragment replacements, inferred target inflection, or arbitrary grammar rewriting.

selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.budget: Retain native whole-word density budget; an over-budget phrase is not truncated to fit. Compare availability and achieved content-token depth separately.
selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.context_vs_focus: Report matched-context UTF16 span and emitted focus UTF16 span independently; a long context with one replaced noun is not a long phrase translation.
selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.top_down: Compare exact candidate longest-first ordering, deterministic ties, source-disjoint ranges and explicit ambiguity-veto semantics. Do not hide an incompatible longer-source claim by dropping to a shorter matching word.
selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.scope: Literal/URL/email/handle/code/name and contraction guards apply before every path; record rejections. Unknown/unmatched slots abstain.
selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.known: Use immutable known-concept snapshot before selection; legacy entries lacking IDs remain explicitly outside that claim. No exposure-as-mastery persistence.
selection_contract_to_freeze_before_outp.origin: No existing target-conditioned record becomes source-authorized merely because its source pattern matches. Data handoff must bind assessed record/hash/scope.

qualification.first: Owner freezes schema, data hashes, arm rules, exact positive/negative authored controls and reused corpus input IDs before native outputs. No candidate training on evaluation outcomes.
qualification.native_probe: Reuse existing emulator/API35 and native tokenizer; optional supplied rows are test-only. No new model downloads. Pure lookup arms make zero translation calls.
capture: all inputs and exact original UTF16/native ranges
every matched context/focus and mapping/concept/record hash
selected/skipped IDs, budget and explicit rejection reasons
first and warm elapsed time, process memory observations and packaged bytes
paired outputs at agreed densities, original/source-script audio unchanged
negative_controls: same spelling with competing senses and a missing target
pronoun/name/possessive slot allowed versus unknown or code/URL text
negation, tense, agreement and sentence boundaries outside approved scope
literal ID preservation including non-BMP/combining marks
repeated occurrences, overlap, over-budget phrase and known-concept filtering
qualification.UI_after_component_evidence: One actual ChatScreens representative phrase/template path with stable continuous flip, Copy original, original-script audio and explicit full-reference extension. Curated demo is not coverage evidence.
qualification.release_baseline: Root-owned separate clean committed snapshot excludes inherited unqualified infinitive deltas. Canonical dirty files remain preserved.
